_comment: Build areas for the inner city, named after the pre-July-2025 urban districts (quận) because open map data, Street View imagery and everyday speech still use them. Hanoi abolished the district level on 1/7/2025 (wards now report straight to the city); the ids below are game zones, not current administrative units. Boxes are west,south,east,north in WGS84 and overlap on purpose so streets along a boundary are built on both sides. All districts share one world origin so their tiles land in one frame.

origin.note: Hồ Hoàn Kiếm; x = east, y = north in metres
